en.bdb: Only one Lord adored in the holy congregation ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur paramesar ik jaan gurmukh dhoojaa bhaau miTaiaa|

en.bdb: Accepting Guru and God as one, the gurmukh has erased the sense of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਲਿ ਢਹਾਇਕੈ ਤਾਲ ਨਦੀ ਦਾ ਨੀਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: haumai paal ddahaikai taal nadhee dhaa neer milaiaa|

en.bdb: Knocking down the wall of ego, the gurmukh has united the pond (self) with the  river (Brahm).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀ ਕਿਨਾਰੈ ਦੁਹ ਵਲੀ ਇਕਦੂ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nadhee kinaarai dhuh valee ikadhoo paaraavaar na paiaa|

en.bdb: Undoubtedly the river remains contained within its two banks neither one knowing the other.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੁਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਤੈ ਫਲਹੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਫਲੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: rukhahu fal tai falahu rukh ik naau fal rukh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: From tree the fruit and from fruit the e are born and in fact both are one though they have different names.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਸੁਝ ਹੈ ਸੁਝੈ ਸੁਝੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee ik sujh hai sujhai sujh na hor dhikhaiaa|

en.bdb: The sun is one in all the six seasons; knowing this, one does not think of different suns.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀਂ ਤਾਰੇ ਚਮਕਦੇ ਦਿਹ ਚੜਿਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਆਖੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raatee(n) taare chamakadhe dheh chaRiaai kin aakh lukaiaa|

en.bdb: At night the stars twinkle but with the break of day under whose command they hide themselves? (they automatically go and likewise with light of knowledge the darkness of ignorance is dispelled of its own).
The holy congregation, the gurmukhs adore the Lord with single-minded devotion.
